capabilities.notes: Parser and executor support READ command semantics with script-relative path resolution and diagnostics; Phase B hardening expanded include-path and malformed-include diagnostic regression coverage.
Legacy FUNCTION numbers map deterministically into canonical ScalarField selections shared by script and GUI flows; known unimplemented equations emit soft-fail diagnostics.
VIEW semantics are implemented through the deterministic legacy-to-Three.js translation layer.
VPOINT camera behavior is implemented and covered by translation-layer and parity regression tests.
MINMAX is represented in shared PlotState and exercised through parser/executor and GUI parity flows; Phase B hardening added malformed /INC shorthand and incomplete axis-pair diagnostic coverage.

Absolute multi-level contour model (AUTOMATIC/INCREMENT/MANUAL) is implemented with deterministic renderer semantics; Phase B hardening added malformed tuple-arity coverage plus /INCREMENT precedence/default-fallback tests and unknown-qualifier diagnostic consistency coverage across contour modes.

PLOT is the shared commit boundary for deterministic RenderIntent generation across script execution and GUI apply flows; Phase B hardening added executor diagnostic-order and SHOW/commit ordering regression coverage.
Range-based WALLS model and GUI controls are implemented with shared PlotState integration.
Range-based SUBSETS model and GUI controls are implemented with shared PlotState integration.
FSURFACE controls and execution semantics are available in script and GUI paths with bounded MVP behavior documented.
TEXT annotations are supported through shared state, parser/executor flow, and GUI controls.

SHOW status output is supported with backend status generation and GUI visibility; Phase B hardening includes commit-boundary tests confirming SHOW-only flows do not emit RenderIntent and SHOW output ordering remains stable across commits.
